'''Feyodor's Tavern''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Capital City (Omman)|Capital City]] on [[Omman Minor]]. The owner, [[Feyodor]], was a noted [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and host. Feyodor's Tavern was a noted hub for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to find contracts and work.<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref>
